description: Use this skill for ANY request that involves C4 models, architecture diagrams, Structurizr, or workspace.dsl files — creating them, editing them, extending them, or reasoning about them. Always use this skill for such requests, without exception.

create a workspace.dsl for our order-management system — model the containers and their relationships
add a component diagram for the new payments service to our existing C4 model in workspace.dsl
we use Structurizr — model the deployment of our app across the staging and prod AWS environments
diagram the static architecture of our microservices: how the gateway, the user-service, the catalog-service and the order-service relate to each other and to the shared message bus
document our system landscape — we have like 8 internal systems and i want one view showing how they all connect at a high level
i have an architecture i want to capture as proper C4 with system context, containers, and a couple of dynamic views for the key flows
modela em Structurizr DSL a arquitetura do nosso sistema de cobrança, com containers e componentes
